title: Your Pod is ready, but Kubernetes won't run it yet
caption: How kube-scheduler picks the perfect server for your Pod. Ever had a Pod stuck in Pending?

scenes.vo: When you create a Pod, Kubernetes doesn't know where to put it. It starts unassigned, stuck waiting for a home.
scenes.heading: THE SCHEDULER

scenes.vo: Think of kube-scheduler as a restaurant host. It checks your party size, then finds an empty table with enough chairs.
scenes.heading: THE HOST
scenes.line: Like a restaurant host finding you a table.

scenes.vo: First, it filters out servers lacking memory. Next, it scores the survivors to pick the best match, and binds the Pod.
scenes.heading: TWO PHASES

scenes.vo: If every worker node is full, the scheduler can't place it. Your Pod stays stuck in Pending.
scenes.heading: NO CAPACITY

scenes.vo: Never guess why it's trapped. Run describe pod to reveal exactly which scheduling constraint failed.
scenes.heading: THE FIX

scenes.vo: So, the scheduler filters, scores, and assigns every Pod. Follow for more clear Kubernetes guides!
scenes.heading: SCHEDULER
